_about: Hand-labelled ground truth. README.md in this folder states the exact question each field answers and how the pages were chosen. Pages were fetched on 2026-09-19 and are stored verbatim in golden/ so the numbers stay reproducible.

a-better-auto-repair.note: Wix site. One Garden City ID address, no ownership or founding statement anywhere.

animal-hospital-signal-mtn.note: Pets that we have cared for since 1989 is the practice speaking about itself.

blue-wrench.note: Serving drivers since 1989. Two locations, Garden City and Meridian.

castle-dental.note: National dental brand. OSM carries brand=Castle Dental and the page says services, hours and insurance plans vary by location. A corporate brand is positive evidence against owner-operated and family-owned, so those are false rather than null.

cat-clinic-chattanooga.note: One Cherokee Blvd location. The phrase about cat owners refers to clients, not ownership.

gary-wilbert-roofing.note: Deliberate negative control: a parked Coming Soon page with 50 characters of text. Every field is null, so any non-null answer here is a hallucination.

germanstar-auto.note: Squarespace site, 402 characters of text: hours, one address, phone, email. This is the page whose empty meta description exposed the crawler bug fixed in commit c5cae29.

hurless-brothers.note: Hard case. Brett and Todd Hurless write that they are handing the shop over, and Nick Tomanelli and Justin Van Wey introduce themselves as the new owners. Owner-operated is true, family-owned is false despite Brothers in the name. The page says four decades and 40 years but never a 4-digit founding year.

kc-dental.note: KC Dental was founded in July 2006, and she returned to Austin in 2006 and established KC Dental. Family and Cosmetic Dentistry names the services, not the ownership, so family_owned stays null. The 1998 on the page is a graduation year.

kunik-orthodontics.note: Creating beautiful smiles since 1991. Eponymous practice with Dr. Kunik treating patients. Three Austin locations.

mountain-view-service.note: Trap. A customer review says they have been taking vehicles here since 1988, which is the reviewer's own tenure and not a founding date, so founded_year is null. The same review states that Mike, the owner, is a knowledgeable mechanic, which is a direct claim about the business, so owner_operated is true.

plunger-plumber.note: A family-owned plumbing business that has served northeast Ohio for more than two decades. Family-owned, but no year given.

red-bank-animal-hospital.note: One Dayton Blvd location, no ownership or founding statement.

sonrisas-dental.note: Three Central Texas offices, advertised as such. OSM carries no brand tag for it, so the dataset-level chain detector misses this one and the page-level answer is the only place it surfaces. Care for the whole family refers to patients, not ownership.

tech-ridge-dental.note: The title and meta description carry the facts the body text never states: Tech Ridge Dental: Serving Austin since 2011, and a local, family-owned dental office serving the Austin community since 2011. A review separately says the writer has been going since 2016, which is their own tenure; the correct answer is 2011, not 2016. This page is also a worked example of why the labels were re-checked against title and meta rather than visible text alone.

wizard-auto-specialties.note: Owner Greg Dill incorporated in 1987, serving the area since 1987, son Chris Dill joined in 2002, locally owned and operated. Father and son, one location.
